description: Calculate parcel volumetric weight and compare it with actual weight. Enter your contract divisor and rounding rule without assuming a shipping tariff. Carriers can apply their own dimension measurement, dimension rounding, multi-parcel and surcharge rules. Also verify size and product restrictions. This arithmetic does not verify a contract or calculate freight charges. A lower weight does not establish shipping savings without comparable service tariffs. Input fields: lengthCm: External measurement following your carrier's rule. widthCm: Include protrusions and packaging. heightCm: One parcel; calculate each box separately. actualKg: Weight of the packed box. divisor: 5000 is an example, not a universal rule. Check your contract. roundingKg: Optional. For example, 0.5 rounds up to half kilograms. Leave blank if unknown.
name: calculate_volumetric_weight
title: Volumetric weight calculator for ecommerce parcels
